scenarios.finding: The main window and helper panel are created before deferred service setup begins.
scenarios.measurement: App Launch covers the main lifecycle, while Points of Interest intervals name helper.services and each helper.services.* phase.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Cold-start phases yield between independent groups, only the newest generation publishes, and cancellation prevents remaining phases.

evidence.contains: guard !Task.isCancelled, let self, generation == currentGeneration else { return }

scenarios.finding: Type-ahead and global hotkeys are event driven, while terminal responders bypass app-wide text discovery and media shortcuts.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest intervals named main.typeAhead and helper.globalHotKey, plus 10,000 focus transitions and 100,000 terminal responder checks.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Input spans preserve stable identity, stale focus work cannot reactivate a hidden terminal, and terminal keystrokes remain local.

scenarios.finding: Dashboard data reads are skipped when the source modification time is unchanged.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named dashboard.load.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Repository loading keeps its unchanged-file early return.

evidence.contains: if let m, m == mtime, data != nil { return }

scenarios.finding: The usage collector owns repository and Git subprocess work outside the interactive input path.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named usage.refresh plus the collector event transcript.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Usage refresh remains asynchronous, cancellable, and assigned utility quality of service.

scenarios.finding: Contributor requests use a daily cache and fall back to cached data when GitHub is unavailable.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named contributors.load.
scenarios.regressionProperty: A failed refresh returns the cached decode without reading the cache twice.

scenarios.finding: Extension readiness is refreshed on demand, and multi-extension reports fan out concurrently.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named extensions.report.
scenarios.regressionProperty: The settings surface keeps a trace around the complete readiness probe.

scenarios.finding: Clipboard history bounds its initial population, and inactive terminal surfaces defer repeated redraws until visible.
scenarios.measurement: The initial clipboard population is capped at 80 rows, while 20,000 terminal output chunks create one deferred inactive redraw pass.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Large clipboard histories stay paged and hidden terminal tabs request one catch-up redraw when reactivated.

scenarios.finding: Contributor cache hit and miss decisions are visible, and one decode is reused across network fallback.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest events named contributors.hit and contributors.miss.
scenarios.regressionProperty: The invalid-cache fallback test permits exactly one content read.

scenarios.finding: Usage collection runs in a utility subprocess and terminates that subprocess when its task is canceled.
scenarios.measurement: The usage.refresh interval covers the worker lifetime and its structured event transcript.
scenarios.regressionProperty: The collector retains utility quality of service and task-cancellation handling.

scenarios.finding: Local and remote project refreshes reject canceled or superseded responses before updating visible state.
scenarios.measurement: Deterministic concurrency tests finish project requests out of order and cancel an in-flight request.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Only the newest project refresh may update the corresponding UI state.

scenarios.finding: Helper CPU, resident memory, and optional idle wakeups can be captured as deterministic JSON summaries.
scenarios.measurement: bench-helper JSON fields cpuPercent, rssMB, and idleWakeups.
scenarios.regressionProperty: A checked fixture fixes median, p95, peak, unit conversion, and schema behavior.

evidence.contains: benchmark fixtures produce stable machine-readable percentiles

scenarios.finding: Every interval records whether it began and ended on the main thread.
scenarios.measurement: The main field on each Points of Interest interval and event.
scenarios.regressionProperty: Trace tests assert main-thread context without wall-clock timing.

scenarios.finding: Large dashboard files decode on a utility task, while aggregation is measured separately.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named dashboard.ingest.
scenarios.regressionProperty: JSON decoding remains detached from the main actor.

scenarios.finding: GitHub contributor fetches have a bounded timeout and preserve cached output on failure.
scenarios.measurement: Points of Interest interval named contributors.fetch.
scenarios.regressionProperty: The request timeout remains explicit and failure fallback stays covered by a local protocol test.
